description: Moderation state of a listing (pending / live / low / hidden / blocked) — poll it after create_listing. No credential; only the decision comes back. Every submission is born `pending` and a person approves it by hand; this is the receipt you poll after `POST /api/listings` (its response carries this URL as `status_api`). Only the decision comes back, never the unreviewed content: the id (`lst_…`, unguessable) is all it takes, and the page itself keeps its rule — owner only until it is public. Answers are cached for 60 s per point of presence: poll every few minutes, not every second.

id.description: Listing ID, from the `id` of the `POST /api/listings` response.

name: listing_status
